items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-16
items.q: The interviewee mentions Sidney Bechet only as part of a list of musicians who left New Orleans by 1913, which he disputes based on his own timeline and knowledge ('Clarence Williams, Bunk Johnson, Sidney Bechet, and Kit Aurey had gone from here by 1913... ctx.x: Pioneer of jazz wins recognition, New Orleans, editor from New Orleans States. It was gratifying to read in your paper on February 27th the article on Nick LaRocca, famous leader of the original Dixieland jazz band. He deserves the honor accorded him and his band by the Jazz Club of England whose leader, Marcus O'Donoghau visited our sea last summer. If Mr. LaRocca accepts this invitation, and I hope he does, I'm sure he will mention some of the other bands that played jazz at that time. Tom Brown, who took his…

I'd like to comment on the dates that she has here to show you she was eaten up, taken in by this communist propaganda. I wish you'd hear this tape recorder. Buddy Bolin, Freddie Kepler, George Pequet left here in 1911. In 1906, by the things that I have in my hand, from Louisiana State Mental Hospital at Jackson, Louisiana, Bolin was incarcerated in there in 1906. He couldn't have played with them. And I've told you when these Negroes came it was 1917. Clarence Williams, he says, left here around 1911 or 13.…
